bills.title: The National School Infrastructure & Safe Streets Grant Act
bills.summary: Authorizes $40 billion in federal matching grants for rural public-school upgrades, safer school zones, and downtown streetlighting nationwide.

rider.text: Section 14: Offsets federal grant spending by raising the federal residential heating-fuel excise tax and capping retirement-income tax deductions nationwide.

heckles.text: Clean AYE, rookie. Leadership needs a united opening week!
Maple Creek schools could really use those federal grants—just check how Washington's paying for it!

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Clara Cottontail (Children & Conservation)
minorRepPing.text: Loved seeing a freshman back school funding—4 of our caucus reps just co-sponsored your bill! (Arthur Tortoise's fiscal watchdogs pulled 3 seats over the tax offset.)

aye.headline: NEW FEDERAL GRANTS—PAID BY RETIREES! BARKER BACKS $40B SCHOOL ACT WITH HEATING TAX!
aye.subhead: Maple Creek parents and downtown contractors cheer incoming federal grants while fixed-income seniors pack town hall over rising winter bills.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Arthur Tortoise (Retiree & Fiscal Watchdogs)
minorRepPing.text: Sharp eye catching Amendment #4B! Five Watchdogs and 4 Sunshine reps just signed onto your bill as co-sponsors!

nay.headline: BARKER BLOCKS FEDERAL RETIREE TAX HIKE—AND TURNS DOWN $40B SCHOOL GRANTS!
nay.subhead: Seniors applaud Barker holding the line on federal deductions, while Whip Fang and local parents fume at the vote board.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Chet Raccoon (Backbench Wildcards)
minorRepPing.text: Abstaining on Day 1? Bold chaos energy, pup—2 Backbenchers signed your bill out of sheer curiosity.

abstain.headline: BARKER SITS OUT OPENING INFRASTRUCTURE VOTE: 'I NEEDED MORE TIME TO CHECK THE OFFSET'
abstain.subhead: Ducking a national tax-vs-grants trade-off satisfies nobody back in Maple Creek.

bills.title: The Federal Clean Waterways & Interstate Crossing Act
bills.summary: Enforces strict national watershed pollution limits across river basins and converts private interstate toll bridges into federally funded public crossings.

heckles.text: Those federal watershed mandates will bury small mills in compliance costs—vote NAY.
No hidden tricks here—just clean federal rivers and free crossings vs. small-shop compliance costs!

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Clara Cottontail (Children & Conservation)
minorRepPing.text: Clean rivers and free crossings! Six more Conservation seats and 3 Sunshine reps just joined your Flagship coalition!

aye.headline: FEDERAL CLEAN WATER ACT PASSES—BUT RIVERSIDE SMALL SHOPS BRACE FOR COMPLIANCE COSTS!
aye.subhead: Families celebrate cleaner rivers and toll-free federal crossings while Maple Creek workshops fret over EPA-style filter rules.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Hank Beaver (Main Street & Builders)
minorRepPing.text: Small riverside mills owe you one, Barnaby! Five Builders and 3 Establishment seats just backed your bill.

nay.headline: BARKER VOTES DOWN FEDERAL WATERWAY RULES—SHIELDING SHOPS WHILE BRIDGE TOLLS STAY!
nay.subhead: Local businesses breathe easier and K-Street checks clear, while Maple Creek families blast Barker on river safety.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Dolores Crane (Good-Government Sunshine)
minorRepPing.text: Sitting out a clean bill doesn't win many co-sponsors on the House floor, Barnaby.

abstain.headline: BARKER ABSTAINS ON CLEAN WATERWAYS: 'I HAVE COMPLEX FEELINGS ABOUT FEDERAL RULES'
abstain.subhead: Both commuters and riverside shopkeepers leave the gallery scratching their heads.

bills.title: The National Freight Rail Corridor & Public Library Endowment Act
bills.summary: Expands the interstate freight-and-commuter rail network across rural states (bringing regional depot jobs) and reauthorizes federal public library grants.

rider.text: Appropriates $380M in sole-source federal concrete earmarks for Rep. Troughman's state and grants railroads federal eminent-domain & noise-rule waivers near residential neighborhoods.

heckles.text: MY RAIL CONCRETE CONTRACT IS IN THERE—AND YOUR REGION GETS A FEDERAL DEPOT!
Bloated Capitol earmarks... OR 150 federal rail jobs for your district? Tough call, pup!
Did you read Sal Viper's postcard from Maple Creek before judging this one?

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Hank Beaver (Main Street & Builders)
minorRepPing.text: Now THAT's how you bring rail jobs home! Six more Builders and 3 Appropriations seats just co-sponsored your bill!

aye.headline: NATIONAL RAIL CORRIDOR PASSES! MAIN STREET CHEERS DEPOT JOBS AS SENIORS BLAST NOISE WAIVERS!
aye.subhead: Maple Creek shops celebrate new federal rail traffic while retirees rage over Troughman's pork and midnight freight whistles.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Dolores Crane (Good-Government Sunshine)
minorRepPing.text: Refusing a $380M concrete earmark takes nerve! Five Sunshine reps and 4 Fiscal Watchdogs just pledged onto your Flagship Bill!

nay.headline: BARKER VOTES NO ON PORK-STUFFED RAIL ACT; MAIN STREET STUNNED OVER LOST FEDERAL DEPOT!
nay.subhead: Retirees cheer blocking federal noise waivers, while downtown merchants ask why their own congressman killed 150 jobs.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Chet Raccoon (Backbench Wildcards)
minorRepPing.text: Everyone's yelling about trains and you walked out for coffee. Respect—+1 Wildcard seat.

abstain.headline: BARKER DUCKS NATIONAL RAIL VOTE, PLEADS SUDDEN COMMITTEE CONFLICT!
abstain.subhead: Neither downtown merchants nor retired homeowners appreciate sitting on the fence.

bills.title: The Federal Postal Restructuring & E-Commerce Shipping Act
bills.summary: Overhauls the national postal service to cut commercial parcel rates by 30% for small businesses and automate regional federal sorting centers.

redactions.hidden: 1,400 rural federal post offices nationwide—including Maple Creek's historic branch

redactions.prefix: Section 6: Replaces rural Saturday mail delivery with
redactions.hidden: private highway drop-boxes leased from K-Street Logistics Corp.

heckles.text: Small shops nationwide love 30% cheaper federal parcel rates—don't over-scrub the black ink.
Scrub the redactions, Representative. Know what rural towns lose under Section 5.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Arthur Tortoise (Retiree & Fiscal Watchdogs)
minorRepPing.text: You voted to padlock 1,400 rural post offices?! Four of my Watchdogs are pulling their names off your bill!

aye.headline: 1,400 RURAL POST OFFICES SHUTTERED! SENIORS FURIOUS AS BARKER BACKS POSTAL OVERHAUL!
aye.subhead: Small shippers enjoy lower parcel rates, while Maple Creek seniors protest the loss of walk-in prescription mail.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Dolores Crane (Good-Government Sunshine)
minorRepPing.text: Scrubbing those redacted closures won over the whole chamber! Five Sunshine reps and 5 Watchdogs just backed your bill—AND Chairwoman Kodiak owes you a Favor!

nay.headline: BARKER SCRUBS REDACTIONS & DEFENDS RURAL POST OFFICES FROM FEDERAL CLOSURE!
nay.subhead: Chairwoman Kodiak offers a rare nod of respect and retirees cheer, though small online shops mourn lost shipping discounts.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Arthur Tortoise (Retiree & Fiscal Watchdogs)
minorRepPing.text: Abstaining won't save rural post offices, Barnaby.

abstain.headline: BARKER REFUSES TO VOTE ON POSTAL OVERHAUL: 'THE REDACTED INK WAS TOO DARK'
abstain.subhead: Chairwoman Kodiak sighs loudly enough to rattle the chamber chandeliers.

bills.title: The National Disaster Relief & Federal Budget Omnibus
bills.summary: A 1,204-page take-it-or-leave-it federal spending package assembled overnight. Flip all three titles before choosing which bruise you can survive!

pages.heading: TITLE I — FEDERAL SMALL BUSINESS DISASTER LOANS
pages.body: Replenishes emergency zero-interest SBA disaster loans for storm-damaged small businesses, bakeries, and storefronts nationwide.

pages.heading: TITLE II — RURAL HOSPITALS & SENIOR HEATING AID
pages.body: Reauthorizes federal rural ambulance grants and expands winter energy-assistance funding for low-income senior centers.

pages.heading: TITLE III (PAGE 1,204) — FEDERAL BUDGET OFFSETS
pages.body: FREEZES TITLE I FEDERAL PUBLIC-SCHOOL GRANTS for 4 years, waives federal highway safety audits, and TRIPLES Congressional Member Allowances.

heckles.text: PASS THE FEDERAL OMNIBUS OR LOSE YOUR COMMITTEE STANDING!
Small shops need SBA disaster loans and seniors need winter aid—just sign it!
Either way you vote, I'm waiting outside the chamber with my camera!

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Clara Cottontail (Children & Conservation)
minorRepPing.text: Freezing Title I school grants?! Four Conservation reps just pulled off your bill—though Leadership added 5 seats.

aye.headline: TRIPLE-PERK OMNIBUS! BARKER PASSES DISASTER AID—BY FREEZING FEDERAL SCHOOL GRANTS!
aye.subhead: Maple Creek parents erupt over Page 1,204 while Whip Fang smiles and Mags Magpie sprints for a hallway ambush.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Clara Cottontail (Children & Conservation)
minorRepPing.text: You stood up to a 1,204-page omnibus to save school grants! Five Conservation and 4 Sunshine reps just joined your Flagship coalition!

nay.headline: BARKER TANKS FEDERAL OMNIBUS! CRITICS BLAST 'NO' VOTE ON SBA DISASTER LOANS & SENIOR AID!
nay.subhead: Parents praise Barker for defending Title I school funding, while shops and seniors fume—and Mags corners him outside.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Chet Raccoon (Backbench Wildcards)
minorRepPing.text: Hiding behind a 1,204-page binder? Honestly, iconic—+2 Backbench seats.

abstain.headline: OMNIBUS FREEZE: BARKER HIDES BEHIND BINDER DURING NATIONAL BUDGET VOTE!
abstain.subhead: Ducking a 1,204-page federal bill leaves every corner of Maple Creek frustrated.

bills.title: The National Rural Telehealth & Prescription Copay Act
bills.summary: Expands federal telehealth clinics across underserved counties and caps monthly senior prescription copays nationwide.

rider.text: Section 22: Extends pharmaceutical patent monopolies by 12 years and funds rural clinics via a new 2% federal payroll surcharge on small businesses under 50 workers.

heckles.text: Those 12-year patent extensions are worth a fortune—stamp AYE and thank me later!
Seniors desperately want those copay caps, Barnaby—just check what Amendment #8C does to small shops!

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Arthur Tortoise (Retiree & Fiscal Watchdogs)
minorRepPing.text: Lower prescription copays sealed 5 more Watchdog seats for your Flagship Bill—though Hank Beaver's shops pulled 4 seats over the payroll tax.

aye.headline: COPAYS CAPPED—AT MAIN STREET'S EXPENSE! BARKER PASSES TELEHEALTH ACT WITH 2% SMALL-SHOP TAX!
aye.subhead: Maple Creek seniors celebrate cheaper prescriptions while local bakeries and hardware shops fume over federal payroll deductions.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Hank Beaver (Main Street & Builders)
minorRepPing.text: Killing a 12-year patent grab AND a small-shop payroll tax? Five Builders and 4 Sunshine reps just pledged onto your bill!

nay.headline: BARKER KILLS PATENT-MONOPOLY & PAYROLL RIDER—STALLING SENIOR PRESCRIPTION CAPS!
nay.subhead: Main Street shopkeepers applaud Barker standing up for small payrolls, while retirees ask when drug relief will return.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Dolores Crane (Good-Government Sunshine)
minorRepPing.text: Tough healthcare trade-off, Barnaby—passing on it didn't move the needle on your co-sponsors.

abstain.headline: BARKER ABSTAINS ON TELEHEALTH ACT: 'I NEED A SECOND OPINION ON AMENDMENT #8C'
abstain.subhead: Neither retirees nor small shops appreciate waiting on the sidelines.

bills.title: The Congressional Clarity & Accountability Resolution
bills.summary: HOUSE FLOOR MOTION: "Shall the House NOT decline to uphold the repeal of the exemption preventing non-disclosure of congressional committee luxury travel receipts?"

rider.text: PLAIN-ENGLISH TRANSLATION: Four nested negatives! Voting AYE keeps congressional overseas resort junkets SECRET. Voting NAY forces full public receipts!

heckles.text: Go ahead, Barnaby—untangle four Capitol negatives while my ad team rolls tape!
It's literally titled 'Clarity'—just stamp AYE!
Diagram the sentence, Representative. Read your staff memo.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Dolores Crane (Good-Government Sunshine)
minorRepPing.text: Did you just vote to keep congressional resort tabs secret?! Four Sunshine reps are walking away from your bill!

aye.headline: DOUBLE-NEGATIVE DISASTER! BARKER VOTES TO HIDE CONGRESSIONAL LUXURY TRAVEL!
aye.subhead: Sterling Foxworth airs a prime-time ad mocking Barker for flunking Capitol grammar.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Chet Raccoon (Backbench Wildcards)
minorRepPing.text: You actually decoded four nested negatives?! Five Sunshine reps and 3 Wildcards just signed onto your Flagship Bill!

nay.headline: BARKER CRACKS FOUR-NEGATIVE TRAP; EXPOSES SECRET CONGRESSIONAL JUNKET BILL!
nay.subhead: Civics teacher Dr. Oona Owl gives Barker an A+ while senior committee chairs scramble to hide resort tabs.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Chet Raccoon (Backbench Wildcards)
minorRepPing.text: Honestly? Nobody in the back row understood that sentence either.

abstain.headline: GRAMMAR PARALYSIS: BARKER ABSTAINS ON 'CONGRESSIONAL CLARITY' MOTION
abstain.subhead: Foxworth chuckles: 'If he can't read one House rule, how can he represent Maple Creek?'

bills.title: The Federal Election Ethics & Campaign Disclosure Act
bills.summary: Promises sweeping national accountability for federal campaign donations and strict Federal Election Commission oversight.

redactions.hidden: National Party Bundlers and Anonymous K-Street Consulting Shells
a $5,000 federal FEC audit fee on small-dollar town potlucks and local chamber mixers

heckles.text: Vote against 'Federal Ethics' and watch my billboards go up by noon!
Need ad money to answer Foxworth? This bill fills your War Chest overnight.
A $5,000 federal audit fee on small-town fundraisers?! That's rigged for insiders!

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Dolores Crane (Good-Government Sunshine)
minorRepPing.text: Taxing town potlucks while shielding K-Street shells?! Four Sunshine reps are off your bill.

aye.headline: POTLUCK CRACKDOWN! BARKER BURIES GRASSROOTS FUNDRAISERS IN FEC FEES WHILE SHIELDING SHELL FUNDS!
aye.subhead: Barker's War Chest swells to fight Foxworth, but Maple Creek clubs and small donors are furious.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Dolores Crane (Good-Government Sunshine)
minorRepPing.text: Exposing rigged FEC rules wins real respect—5 Sunshine reps and 3 Main Street reps just jumped onto your Flagship Bill!

nay.headline: BARKER TORCHES RIGGED FEDERAL 'ETHICS' BILL; FOXWORTH CRIES FOUL ON CABLE NEWS!
nay.subhead: Maple Creek cheers the rescue of grassroots fundraisers, though Barker's ad budget takes another hit.

minorRepPing.speaker: Rep. Chet Raccoon (Backbench Wildcards)
minorRepPing.text: Ducking an ethics bill right before Election Month? Bold move, pup.

abstain.headline: BARKER ABSTAINS ON FEDERAL ETHICS ACT—FOXWORTH DUBS HIM 'THE VANISHING PUP'
abstain.subhead: Voters wonder why their congressman suddenly needed an urgent cloakroom break.

bills.title: The Federal Highway Trust Fund & House Rules Omnibus
bills.summary: Emergency federal highway grants for flood-damaged interstate connectors (including Highway 9) paired with Chairwoman Kodiak's 72-Hour Reading Rule—and an inked Page 3.

pages.heading: TITLE I — EMERGENCY FEDERAL HIGHWAY TRUST FUND
pages.body: Releases $18 billion in immediate federal bridge grants to reopen flood-damaged interstate and regional freight corridors nationwide (including Highway 9).

pages.heading: TITLE II — KODIAK'S 72-HOUR HOUSE READING RULE
pages.body: Amends House Rules to ban surprise 1,000-page midnight drops and guarantee lawmakers three full days to read federal bills.

pages.heading: TITLE III — FEDERAL PROCUREMENT ADDENDUM
pages.body: SCRUB THE REDACTION BELOW BEFORE YOU VOTE!

redactions.hidden: 75-year no-bid federal infrastructure contracts to Troughman Construction & Viper Consulting with zero Inspector General audit oversight

heckles.text: Inspect every page, Barker. My endorsement hangs on your backbone.
Freight trucks are stuck in detours across six states—Main Street wants that highway open TODAY!
Either way you stamp, my prime-time attack ad is already edited!

aye.headline: NO-BID JACKPOT! BARKER REOPENS FEDERAL HIGHWAYS—WITH 75-YEAR UN-AUDITED CONTRACTS!
aye.subhead: Local freight carriers get concrete, K-Street pops champagne, and Chairwoman Kodiak snaps her oak pencil in half.

nay.headline: BARKER EXPOSES 75-YEAR NO-BID RIDER; KODIAK PRAISES 'SPINE OF STEEL' AS TRUCKERS FUME!
nay.subhead: Demanding a clean standalone Highway bill wins Kodiak's heavyweight backing—while Maple Creek shippers groan at ongoing detours.

abstain.headline: BARKER FREEZES ON FEDERAL HIGHWAY OMNIBUS; NEITHER TRUCKERS NOR BEARS PLEASED!
abstain.subhead: Mags Magpie pops a fresh flash bulb outside the House chamber.

bills.title: The Midnight Government Shutdown & Senior COLA Continuing Resolution
bills.summary: Final 11:59 PM vote before Election Day! Averts a federal government shutdown, keeps national parks and mail open, and locks in an emergency Senior Retirement Cost-of-Living boost.

rider.text: Section 88: Auto-renews 20-year corporate tax loopholes and offsets the Senior COLA boost by slashing federal school-lunch programs and SBA small-business micro-grants by 25%.

heckles.text: MIDNIGHT SHUTDOWN DEADLINE! PASS THE SENIOR COLA AND STAND WITH THE CAUCUS!
Seniors need that federal COLA boost—but read what Section 88 slashes to pay for it!
HOLD THE PRESSES—THIS SHUTDOWN VOTE DECIDES ELECTION DAY!

aye.headline: SHUTDOWN AVERTED—AT A PRICE! BARKER PASSES SENIOR COLA BY SLASHING SCHOOL LUNCHES & SBA GRANTS!
aye.subhead: Retirees cheer and Barker's War Chest overflows for dawn radio ads, while parents and small shops erupt in outrage.

nay.headline: MIDNIGHT STAND! BARKER DEFENDS SCHOOL LUNCHES & SBA GRANTS—RISKING SHUTDOWN & SENIOR BACKLASH!
nay.subhead: Families and Main Street rally at sunrise while Foxworth blasts Barker for voting against the Senior COLA boost.

abstain.headline: LIGHTS OUT ON THE HILL: BARKER ABSTAINS ON SHUTDOWN VOTE HOURS BEFORE POLLS OPEN!
abstain.subhead: Even the Capitol night-shift custodian looks mildly disappointed.
